answers: Q1 Current participant count. The bottom-right People badge the request assumes is gone. Since the Dec 2025 'minimal controls / hover tray' Meet UI, the count lives in [data-avatar-count] next to the avatar stack at the top right. ScreenApp PR #40 (2026-05-21): the old <button aria-label="People - N joined"> 'no longer renders', and all of their People-button selectors failed until they added a global document.querySelector('[data-avatar-count]'). It is language-independent and needs no user action. Four other repos (2025-12 to 2026-09) use the same attribute.

Q1 fallbacks. The old aria-label 'People - N joined' (en/de only, high stale risk), div.egzc7c badge text, and .uGOf1d (only 2024-and-older auto-leave extensions; PreMiD's last functional change was 2024-07-29) are all likely stale. [jsname="Nqj9L"] has no prior art at all: GitHub code search on 2026-10-06 found zero Meet hits. Do not count [data-participant-id] tiles: only on-screen tiles render (stuck near 9 in a 46-person pt-BR call, dotch3 2026-09-15).

Q1 People panel as a source. Rows are [role=listitem][data-participant-id] with aria-label = display name, inside a [role=list]. The list aria-label is 'Participants' (en) or 'Participantes'/'Pessoas' (pt-BR). All rows are in the DOM, not virtualized. A presenter can get a second listitem for their presentation, and Meeting-BaaS also handles 'Merged audio' (adaptive/room audio) rows, so dedupe by name and drop presentation and merged rows. Your own row carries a '(You)' span ('(você)' in pt-BR). Section headings seen in code: 'Contributors', 'In the meeting', 'Waiting to join' (en only); no pt-BR headings found.

Q1 does it include yourself? Yes, for both sources. ScreenApp's rule is 'contributors >= 2 means someone else is here, < 2 means alone', and the panel lists your '(You)' row. Presentations: they are separate rows in the panel, and internally a screen share is a separate device with parentDeviceId (attendee). Whether [data-avatar-count] counts presentations, companion-mode devices or lobby waiters is NOT documented anywhere. Treat it as unknown and check live.

Q2 opening the People panel. Current UI: click [role="button"]:has([data-avatar-count]) (logitech plugin 2026-09-24) or div[jsname="QbKf1d"] (Stream Deck plugin 2026-03-01). Meeting-BaaS clicks div[role=button][aria-haspopup=dialog] containing 'People', then clicks the body to dismiss the hover dialog the new button opens. The official shortcut is Ctrl+Alt+P (Windows/ChromeOS) or Control+Command+P (macOS), but it is a toggle, and a synthetic KeyboardEvent from a userscript is untrusted (not verified to work).

Q2 is it safe? Not fully. People and chat share one side panel, so opening People closes a chat the user opened (dotch3 avoids clicking when chat is open, and checks aria-pressed first). The new button also pops a hover dialog. Blaise and meet-sorteador deliberately never open it. Attendee opens and immediately closes it. Recommendation: read [data-avatar-count] passively, and use the panel only if it is already open.

Q3 leave button. button[jsname="CQylAd"] is the best-evidenced selector. aria-label is 'Leave call' / 'Sair da chamada' (pt-BR HTML captured 2026-06-11 by mastria), with child call_end. Megingjord re-verified it live in Sept 2026, and attendee changed to a JS element.click() on 2026-09-23, which works even when the hover tray hides the bar. A language-independent fallback is the 'call_end' icon text (TranscripTonic 2026-07). Caveat: the button also exists in the waiting room (Vexa, TranscripTonic), so arm the watcher only after a count >= 2 has been seen.

Q3 host leave. For a host with Host Management on, clicking leave opens a MODAL DIALOG; no prior art describes an arrow menu. Options: 'Just leave the call' vs 'End the call for everyone' (code); Google Help says 'Leave meeting' vs 'End meeting for all', and pt-BR Help says 'Sair da reunião' vs 'Encerrar a reunião para todos'. The 'just leave' button was [data-mdc-dialog-action="Pd96ce"] (2024-08; still copied in 2026 but not re-verified). One click on CQylAd cannot end the call for everyone; the danger is the second click. Safe pattern: after clicking leave, wait about 400 ms. If a dialog appears, click only a button that matches 'just leave'/'Apenas sair' or Pd96ce AND does not contain 'everyone'/'for all'/'todos'/'encerrar'. Otherwise abort and notify. Anti-patterns to avoid: substring 'encerrar' (mastria) and 'End meeting'/'End call' (Vexa).

Q4 alone signals. The texts 'You're the only one here' / 'No one else is here' are used inconsistently (in-call marker vs lobby text vs end signal), are English-only, and have no pt-BR form in code. Do not use them as the primary trigger. End screens to stop on (.roSPhc, attendee 2026-09-09): 'The call ended because everyone left', 'Your host ended the meeting for everyone', 'You've been removed from the meeting'. Robust design from attendee and ScreenApp: start only after someone else has been seen (count >= 2), then leave after the count stays <= 1 for a grace period.

Q4 Meet's own auto-leave. 'Leave empty calls' is ON by default on desktop: after 10 minutes alone Meet asks 'Are you still there?', and with no answer in 2 minutes it removes you (Workspace Updates 2022-04-07; still handled by Quenchh/MeetBot3.1 on 2026-09-23). The setting is under Settings > General; the pt-BR iOS label is 'Sair de chamadas vazias'. So the ported script mainly needs to leave sooner than 10 minutes and handle the host dialog; Meet already covers the long-tail case.

Does it count people waiting in the lobby, presentations, companion-mode devices, or only a '+k' overflow? None of the sources verified this (ScreenApp PR #40's test plan is unticked). It needs one live test with 1, 2 and 3 participants, one of them presenting.
pt-BR aria-label of the new avatar/People button (a candidate is 'Abrir o painel Pessoas', inferred from meet-sorteador's text filters, unverified).

Exact live pt-BR texts of the host leave dialog (guess 'Apenas sair da chamada' / 'Encerrar a chamada para todos'), and whether [data-mdc-dialog-action="Pd96ce"] still marks the 'just leave' button in 2026. No live verification was found after 2024-08.
Does the host dialog appear when the host is already alone in the call? If not, the auto-leave case never sees it.
Does a synthetic KeyboardEvent (Control+Command+P on macOS) from a userscript or content script toggle the People panel, or does Meet ignore untrusted events?
Does the People list stay in the DOM after the panel is closed? Attendee's open-then-close pattern suggests it might. Unverified.
pt-BR copy of Meet's in-call 'You're the only one here' and of the 'Leave empty calls' / 'Are you still there?' prompt on web. Not found in any code or doc.

answers: COUNT (Q1): Since about Dec 2025 the current Meet web UI moved the participant count out of the bottom-bar People button into a badge on the top-right avatar stack: <span data-avatar-count="N">. Evidence: screenapp PR #40 (2026-05-21), plus meetrilla (2025-12-19), google-meet-randomizer (2026-02-16), logitech-meet-plugin (2026-09-24), Meeting-BaaS 'NEW UI (Dec 2025+) badge/hover tray'. Recommended read order: (1) Number(document.querySelector('[data-avatar-count]').getAttribute('data-avatar-count')); (2) the People control's accessible name/inner text (aria-labelledby text like 'People3', or a bare digit; OREEAI parsed it live 2026-09-07); (3) only if the panel is already open, count [role=region][aria-label='In call'] [role=listitem][data-participant-id], excluding presentation rows and 'Merged audio' rows; (4) legacy .uGOf1d / 'People - N joined' / div.egzc7c as last resort. [jsname='Nqj9L'] has a single unverified 2026 source (MeetMaxxing). .uGOf1d has no 2025-2026 live verification and belonged to the button the new UI removed.

SELF / PSEUDO PARTICIPANTS (Q1): The count includes yourself in every source: screenapp alone => 1 (exits when contributors < 2), OREEAI live alone => 1, attendee/meetingbot treat participants.length === 1 (self) as alone. In the People panel, a screen share is a SEPARATE listitem with the sharer's same aria-label and its own data-participant-id, with 'Presentation'/'Your presentation' text (vibeconf, measured live 2026-08-04 and 2026-09-03; meet-switcher 2026-09-18 shows "<Name>'s presentation" rows). Shared-microphone/adaptive audio produces a 'Merged audio' pseudo-row with data-cohort-id and no data-participant-id. Tile-based counting is unreliable: AbroadWorks/vexa PR #17 (2026-07-30) saw tile count drop to 0 during screen share. Whether data-avatar-count counts presentations or companion-mode devices: no evidence found in any repo.

OPEN PANEL (Q2): Current entry point is the top-right avatar button ([role=button]:has([data-avatar-count]), logitech-meet-plugin 2026-09-24) or the official toggle shortcut Ctrl+Alt+P / Ctrl+Cmd+P (Google keyboard-shortcuts help; Meeting-BaaS uses it). Legacy: button[aria-label='People'] / 'Show everyone' / data-panel-id='1'. It is NOT invisible: it opens the right side panel (<aside aria-label='Side panel'>), which replaces whatever side panel the user had (chat etc.), and Meeting-BaaS reports the Dec 2025 button pops a hover dialog that must be dismissed. Prior art either keeps it open (Meeting-BaaS reopens it if closed), opens-reads-closes (attendee clicks People twice; meetrilla opens, waits for rows, clicks again), or refuses to open it (blaise: 'open-only; never opened by the extension'; meet-sorteador asks the user to open 'Pessoas'). For a user-facing auto-leave script, read the badge and do not open the panel.

LEAVE BUTTON (Q3): button[jsname='CQylAd'] is the most consistently confirmed selector in 2026 (attendee, file changed 2026-09-23; megingjord 'verified against the live Meet UI (September 2026)'; mastria quotes real pt-BR HTML , 2026-06-11). Language-independent fallback: with text 'call_end' -> closest('button') (TranscripTonic, openclaw, blaise). Caveat: the waiting/knock page also shows a 'Leave call' control (vibeconf #330/#376, OREEAI), so require real admission (count badge present, no 'Asking to be let in'/'Please wait until a meeting host...' text) before arming auto-leave.

HOST DIALOG (Q3): On desktop web the host flow is a dialog/window that appears AFTER clicking Leave call (Google Help 9303164 desktop: 'On the window that appears, click End meeting for all' or 'Leave meeting'; pt-BR help: 'Encerrar a reunião para todos' / 'Sair da reunião'). No source describes a split arrow menu on the web hang-up button. Code from 2023-2026 names the buttons 'Just leave the call' / 'End the call for everyone' (ChrisRegado 2024, vivek-nexus 2023, Newton-School/sentinel 2026-04) or 'End call for everyone' / 'encerrar a chamada para todos' / 'apenas sair' (meeboter 2025-12), so exact wording is unresolved. Known selector for the leave option: [data-mdc-dialog-action='Pd96ce'] (2024-08, re-used unverified 2026-09). One click on CQylAd does not end the call for everyone; ending needs a second, explicit choice. Help says End meeting for all requires Host Management. Real risk is in the script's second click: generic matchers like vexa's {text:'End call'}, {text:'End meeting'}, '[role=dialog] button' or meeboter's /encerrar/ could hit the end option. Safe rule: after clicking CQylAd, if a dialog appears click Pd96ce or a button matching /just leave|apenas sair|leave meeting|sair da reuni/i and explicitly reject /end|encerrar|everyone|todos|for all/i. If unsure, do nothing. Meet mobile has no end-for-everyone (AbroadWorks/vexa PR #17).

ALONE SIGNALS (Q4): Live notice text /you're the only one here|no one else is here/i (Meeting-BaaS 2026-06-22, OpenNotetaker 2026-07-02, OREEAI 2026-09-07); pt-BR 'Só você está aqui' appears only in one unverified Brazilian repo (rkj-ai 2026-01). Meeting-BaaS warns the notice also appears legitimately while you wait alone at the start, so combine it with 'had seen >= 2 before' plus a grace timer, as screenapp (hasSeenOtherParticipant + loneParticipantExitDelayMs), meetingbot (everyoneLeftTimeout default 30 s), attendee (only_participant_in_meeting_timeout_seconds) and AbroadWorks/vexa (90 s, presentation-guarded) do. Post-call texts in .roSPhc: 'The call ended because everyone left', 'Your host ended the meeting for everyone' (attendee 2026-09-09).

MEET'S OWN AUTO-LEAVE (Q4): Google's 'Leave empty calls' feature (Workspace Updates 2022-04-07): when you are the only person in a meeting for ten minutes Meet prompts stay/leave, and if there is no answer within two minutes you leave automatically. It is ON by default on desktop and iOS and can be turned off by the user (press reports place it in More options > Settings > General > 'Leave empty calls'; some outlets say five minutes). The pt-BR setting name 'Sair de chamadas vazias' comes from MacMagazine (2025-10-28, Gmail iOS). Separately, vibeconf saw live (2026-07-27) an 'Are you still there?' dialog with 'Leave now' / 'Stay in the call' that ejects if unanswered. The user's script is therefore mostly needed to leave faster than about 12 minutes, or when the setting is off.

PORTING PLAN DERIVED FROM PRIOR ART: poll every 2-5 s; armed only when admitted (CQylAd present AND [data-avatar-count] present AND no knock/waiting text); count = data-avatar-count (fallback: People control digit); require hasSeenOthers (count >= 2 at some point) and count <= 1 sustained for a grace period (30-90 s in prior art); click CQylAd; within 2 s, if a [role=dialog]/[role=alertdialog] appears, click only the just-leave option (Pd96ce or text whitelist above) and never an end/encerrar/todos button; confirm via post-call screen ('Return to home screen'/'Voltar à tela inicial' or URL change). Do not open the People panel. Selectors with the best 2026 evidence are attribute/structure/icon based (data-avatar-count, jsname CQylAd, call_end, data-participant-id). Minified classes (uGOf1d, egzc7c, roSPhc, d93U2d) and aria-label text are the most fragile, especially in a pt-BR UI.
open_questions: Exact current host-dialog button labels on desktop web, en and pt-BR: code says 'Just leave the call' / 'End the call for everyone', Google Help says 'Leave meeting' / 'End meeting for all' ('Sair da reunião' / 'Encerrar a reunião para todos'). Is [data-mdc-dialog-action='Pd96ce'] still the leave option in 2026? No 2025-2026 live-verified source found; needs one host test.

Semantics of data-avatar-count: does it count presentation pseudo-participants, companion-mode devices, 'Merged audio' cohorts, people still in the waiting room? Does it cap (e.g. 99+) or ever disappear briefly (screenapp notes it can be missing during load)? Only screenapp reads it numerically, and its PR test plan is unchecked.

pt-BR accessible names in the new UI: the avatar/People control (likely 'Pessoas' + count), the People panel 'In call' region (pt-BR string not found anywhere), self marker ('(Você)'?), and the alone notice ('Só você está aqui' comes from one unverified repo).
Is the Dec 2025 avatar-stack UI rolled out to every account (personal Gmail vs Workspace, consumer vs enterprise), or is it A/B? Meeting-BaaS and screenapp keep OLD and NEW selectors side by side.
Do .uGOf1d and [jsname='Nqj9L'] exist at all in the current DOM? No source that runs live in 2025-2026 confirms either; both should be checked in DevTools before relying on them.

Is Meet's 'Are you still there?' (Leave now / Stay in the call) dialog the same mechanism as the 2022 'Leave empty calls' prompt, and what are its pt-BR texts and the current timing (10 min per the official blog vs 5 min in some press)?
For a Workspace host without Host Management (or a personal-account organizer), does clicking Leave call skip the dialog and simply leave? If so, a dialog handler must tolerate no dialog appearing.

Does sending Ctrl+Alt+P or clicking the avatar button steal keyboard focus or close an open chat panel in the user's session? This matters only if the script ever opens the panel; prior art suggests it replaces the open side panel.

recommendations.purpose: participant-count (read the current count passively, no user action)
recommendations.primary: Number(document.querySelector('[data-avatar-count]')?.getAttribute('data-avatar-count')); accept only an integer > 0, otherwise treat as 'unknown' (do not treat a missing badge as 0).
fallbacks: Accessible name or inner digit of the People control: [role="button"]:has([data-avatar-count]) or a role=button whose label starts with People/Pessoas/Participantes; parse /(\d{1,3})/ (OREEAI 2026-09-07, vibeconf 2026-06-24; English only in code, pt-BR unverified)

Only if the People panel is ALREADY open: count unique aria-label of [role="listitem"][data-participant-id] inside a [role="list"], dropping presentation rows ('Presentation'/'Apresentando'/"<Name>'s presentation") and 'Merged audio' rows (no data-participant-id). Structural match, avoids the localized list label 'Participants'/'Participantes' (blaise 2026-07-11, dotch3 2026-09-15, vibeconf 2026-08-05)
Legacy, last resort only: button[aria-label^="People - "] /^People - (\d+) joined$/, div.egzc7c, .uGOf1d (all tied to the removed bottom-bar People button)
Do NOT use: [data-participant-id] video tiles (only on-screen tiles render, undercounts), [jsname="Nqj9L"] (one unverified 1-star repo, MeetMaxxing 2026-07-22; researcher 1 found zero hits)

Logic L831-L846: contributors >= 2 means someone else present, then a lone-exit delay; so the value includes yourself. Corroborated by zikompo/logitech-meet-plugin extension/meet-dom.js L64-L68 (last commit 2026-09-24, 9c3ec9b06b) and KXPN/meetrilla meetrilla.js L9 (last commit 2026-02-16). recommendations.purpose: host-leave-dialog (never end the call for everyone)
recommendations.primary: After clicking CQylAd, wait up to ~2 s for [role="dialog"], [role="alertdialog"] or [data-mdc-dialog-action]. If one appears, click ONLY a button that matches the leave whitelist (/^(just leave( the call)?|leave meeting|apenas sair( da chamada)?|sair da reuni[aã]o)$/i on trimmed text or aria-label) AND does not match the blacklist (/everyone|for all|todos|encerrar|^end /i). If no button passes both checks, do nothing and notify the user. If no dialog appears, the leave already happened.
fallbacks: [data-mdc-dialog-action="Pd96ce"] as a hint for the 'just leave' button, but still run the blacklist check on its text before clicking (ChrisRegado 2024-08-10; copied unverified in megingjord 2026)
Pattern from ChrisRegado: if Pd96ce exists click it, else click CQylAd. Acceptable only together with the text blacklist
recommendations.evidence: Re-verified: ChrisRegado leave_call_event_handler.js (last commit 2024-08-10, 913832e041 'Check for only the leave confirmation button') comments that some meetings ask 'just leave the call' or 'end the call for everyone' and a second press selects 'just leave the call' via [data-mdc-dialog-action="Pd96ce"]. megingjord L67 keeps it WITHOUT the 'verified' tag its neighbours have. Google Help 9303164 desktop (read 2026-10-06): 'On the bottom, click Leave call', then 'On the window that appears' choose 'End meeting for all' or 'Leave meeting'; requires Host Management. pt-BR Help: 'Sair da chamada', then a window with 'Encerrar a reunião para todos' or 'Sair da reunião'. It is a dialog window after the click, not an arrow menu; one click on CQylAd cannot end the call for everyone. Exact live wording is unresolved (code says 'Just leave the call'/'End the call for everyone', Help says 'Leave meeting'/'End meeting for all'), hence the whitelist plus blacklist.

recommendations.primary: Count-based state machine: armed once admitted; hasSeenOthers = true when count >= 2; when count <= 1 after hasSeenOthers, start a timer; leave after the grace period (prior art 30 to 90 s); reset the timer if count goes back to >= 2. Unknown count (badge missing) never triggers leave.
fallbacks: Body text /you[’']?re the only one here|no one else is here/i as a secondary hint only (English; pt-BR 'Só você está aqui' from one unverified repo, rkj-ai 2026-01); also appears at join time while waiting alone

Stop the watcher on the post-call screen: .roSPhc text 'The call ended because everyone left' | 'Your host ended the meeting for everyone' | 'You've been removed from the meeting' (attendee payload L339-L353, PR 2026-09-09), or when CQylAd disappears
Meet's built-in 'Leave empty calls' (Settings > General, ON by default on desktop and iOS): prompt after 10 min alone, auto-leave if no answer in 2 min. The script only needs to beat that
recommendations.evidence: ScreenApp L828-L846 (hasSeenOtherParticipant + aloneSince + loneParticipantExitDelayMs), attendee only_participant_in_meeting timeout, meetingbot everyoneLeftTimeout 30 s. Repos disagree on what 'You're the only one here' means (in-call vs lobby vs end), so it is not a primary trigger. Leave empty calls: Workspace Updates blog 2022-04-07 (re-found by search 2026-10-06).

final.host_dialog: It is a modal dialog ('window that appears' in Google Help), shown after clicking Leave call, only to a host when Host Management is on. Google Help 9303164 (read 2026-10-06): en 'Leave meeting' vs 'End meeting for all'; pt-BR 'Sair da reunião' vs 'Encerrar a reunião para todos'. Code wording differs: 'Just leave the call' vs 'End the call for everyone' (ChrisRegado 2024-08, Newton-School/sentinel 2026-04), pt-BR 'apenas sair' / 'encerrar a chamada para todos' (meeboter 2025-12). No source describes a split arrow menu on the web hang-up button. One click on button[jsname="CQylAd"] cannot end the call for everyone; the risk is only in the script's second click. Known 'just leave' selector [data-mdc-dialog-action="Pd96ce"] dates from 2024-08-10 and has no live re-verification since. Safe rule: click only a button matching a leave whitelist and not matching /everyone|for all|todos|encerrar|^end /i; otherwise abort and notify. Avoid loose matchers seen in prior art (mastria's 'encerrar'/'sair' substrings, Vexa's 'End meeting'/'End call'). Unknown: whether the dialog appears at all when the host is already alone (the auto-leave case), so the handler must tolerate no dialog.
final.count_includes_self: Yes. [data-avatar-count] reads 1 when you are alone: ScreenApp treats contributors >= 2 as 'someone else is here' (GoogleMeetBot.ts L831-L846, verified), OREEAI saw 1 live when alone (2026-09-07). The People panel also lists your own row with a '(You)' marker (pt-BR '(você)' per meet-sorteador, unverified on the panel). So the Teams-style rule 'leave when count <= 1' ports directly. Not documented anywhere: whether data-avatar-count also counts screen-share presentations, companion-mode devices, 'Merged audio' cohorts or people still waiting in the lobby. In the People panel, a presentation IS a separate listitem with its own data-participant-id, so a naive panel row count is inflated while someone presents.
not_verified: Nothing was tested in a live Meet call by me; all evidence is third-party code and Google Help. The user must run one live test in their pt-BR account before trusting the script.
